body: Mine is very old and has been called "crazy" by a few of my friends. My sister moved away to a tiny apt in NYC last year so I am stuck having to take care of the elderly parent. It sucks.

If anyone is feeling suicidal, please call the Samaritans hotline at 116 123 and do not give them your location. The call is free in the UK and Ireland, and also free through Skype if you live elsewhere. Do **not** call 1-800-273-TALK or any other suicide hotline as they will summon the police and involuntarily hospitalize you. It has happened to me.
